thread:
sanjay: quick heads-up: onboarding Orpheus-v1 (q4 quant) showed a clear locale regression. zh->ar examples with Arabic‑Indic numerals are getting their digits mirrored and trailing punctuation attached to the wrong side. BLEU on our locale suite dropped 4.1 -> 1.9. anyone seen digit/orientation flips like this?
liyue: hmm not exactly that but we've seen weirdness when mixed-script spans hit the bidi postproc. can you paste a repro pair and the tokenizer/detok config?
oliver: also which detok release? we recently merged a small perf patch for short-span normalization. could be interacting with q4 packing.
sanjay: repro command: `./eng-ml/evals/run_locale_eval --model orpheus-v1 --quant q4 --pairs zh-ar --subset mixed-numerals`
sanjay: src: "公元2026年有三家医院位于开罗。" ref (expected ar): "في عام ٢٠٢٦، توجد ثلاث مستشفيات في القاهرة." Orpheus-q4 output: "في عام ٦٠٢٢، توجد ثلاث مستشفيات في القاهرة." (digits reordered and comma moved)
maria: that output is telling — digits became a different permutation. if tokens are correct but detok constructs the wrong sequence, it's a postproc bug. do tokens look right?
kai: FYI the q4 packer changes memory grouping for throughput (packs 4-bit lanes into bytes differently). our detok C-extension has an in-place short-span reverse used for numeric reordering optimization; it assumes byte iteration order. packer reordering could break that.
oliver: can we run a verbose token decode: `python -m orpheus.decode --model orpheus-v1-q4 --emit-tokens --input '公元2026年有三家医院位于开罗。'` and paste the token boundaries around the number?
ml-ci-bot: build 2024.11.03-orph-q4 triggered - staging smoke locale-mixed-numerals failing (3/5). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/1749997777/logs
liyue: pulled the token dump: tokens for the numeric span are the correct Unicode codepoints (U+0662 U+0660 U+0662 U+0666) in order, but the detok output string ends up as U+0666 U+0660 U+0662 U+0662. so detok receives correct tokens and then produces a reversed subseq.
maria: confirms detok-level reverse. quick mitigation: disable the "short_numeric_span_reverse" pass in detok and re-run staging. if that fixes, we can ship a targeted detok patch. I'll add a unit test with mixed Han + Arabic‑Indic numerals + punctuation.
kai: good plan. long term we should make that pass layout-agnostic or rely on an FP16 fallback detok for quant builds. I'll add a CI gate that runs mixed-orientation locale-smoke on any quant build.
oliver: if disabling the pass is low-risk, queue that as an emergency staging run. otherwise fallback to using fp16 detok for q4 until we fix it.
ml-ci-bot: job queued: detok-disable-short-reverse -> staging smoke. estimated 12m.
sanjay: queued. thanks — Maria, can you own the patch? add the unit test and a short changelog note.
maria: taking it. will PR the detok revert + unit, target patch release this afternoon.
kai: I'll follow up with a small perf note and CI gate change. we may accept a tiny detok perf hit to preserve correctness.
oliver: thanks team. please paste staging result back here. :thumbsup:
